day5_after_cage_3.speaker: me
day5_after_cage_3.text: *Teacher smiled. For the first time in 12 cycles, it was the smile of someone who no longer had to wait for the result.*

day5_after_cage_5.speaker: me
day5_after_cage_5.text: *Teacher took my shoulders and turned me back toward my seat. Her fingertips were cold.*

day5_after_cage_6.speaker: me
day5_after_cage_6.text: *I went back to the classroom. Sat down. Sea sits next to me. Nurse Riin hands me tea. Everyone is smiling.*

day5_after_cage_7.speaker: eunsu
day5_after_cage_7.text: ...{name} only has to stay here. In the seat written in the attendance book.

day5_after_cage_8.speaker: me
day5_after_cage_8.text: *I drank the tea. It's warm. It's nice. ...Somewhere — I think I hear a voice. 'Run,' it says. But from far away, very far away.*

day5_after_cage_9.speaker: me
day5_after_cage_9.text: *...Was this smile always this unfamiliar? No. It's familiar. ...Too familiar. ...Why does it feel so comfortable?*

day5_after_cage_10.speaker: me
day5_after_cage_10.text: *...I feel like I'm forgetting something. What was it? ...It's fine. I can forget. It's safe here.*

day5_after_caught_1.speaker: me
day5_after_caught_1.text: *...I opened my eyes. Fluorescent lights flickering. Concrete ceiling. The basement.*

day5_after_caught_2.speaker: me
day5_after_caught_2.text: *I tried to move my hands. They won't move. ...Leather straps. Strapped to a chair.*

day5_after_caught_3.speaker: me
day5_after_caught_3.text: *The same as in Seolhwa's dream. Same chair. Same straps. Same fluorescent light.*

day5_after_caught_5.speaker: eunsu
day5_after_caught_5.text: ...You attempted deviation? Do you know how dangerous that is?

day5_after_caught_6.speaker: riin
day5_after_caught_6.text: I'll prepare the final checkup. Just need to draw blood and hook up the IV.

day5_after_caught_7.speaker: me
day5_after_caught_7.text: *Nurse Riin swabs the inside of my elbow. The cold of the alcohol pad touches my skin. ...I can't give up here.*

day5_after_caught_resist_1.speaker: me
day5_after_caught_resist_1.text: *I tensed every muscle. The leather straps dig into my wrists. It hurts. I don't care.*

day5_after_caught_resist_2.speaker: me
day5_after_caught_resist_2.text: Get your hands off me...! Stop...!

day5_after_caught_resist_3.speaker: riin
day5_after_caught_resist_3.text: If you move, it's dangerous. Stay still—

day5_after_caught_resist_4.speaker: me
day5_after_caught_resist_4.text: *At that moment. The power went out.*

day5_after_caught_resist_5.speaker: me
day5_after_caught_resist_5.text: *In the darkness... I feel a hand. Cold, translucent. Undoing the leather straps. ...Seolhwa.*

day5_after_caught_resist_6.speaker: me
day5_after_caught_resist_6.text: *The straps came undone. Seolhwa takes my hand. I thought a translucent hand couldn't be grasped... but it can.*

day5_after_caught_resist_7.speaker: me
day5_after_caught_resist_7.text: *Pulled through the darkness. Muffling our footsteps. Toward the emergency exit.*

day5_after_caught_submit_1.speaker: me
day5_after_caught_submit_1.text: *...The strength drains away. No energy left to resist. My head drops. My eyes close.*

day5_after_caught_submit_2.speaker: me
day5_after_caught_submit_2.text: *The syringe touches my arm. The needle goes in. Cold liquid spreads through my veins.*

day5_after_caught_submit_3.speaker: me
day5_after_caught_submit_3.text: *...It grows warm. Like my body is melting. Thoughts blur.*

day5_after_caught_submit_4.speaker: me
day5_after_caught_submit_4.text: *I'm... forgetting something. What am I forgetting? It was important... what was it...*

day5_after_confront_1.speaker: me
day5_after_confront_1.text: *From behind — footsteps. Coming up the stairs. One step. One step. Slow. Not running.*

day5_after_confront_2.speaker: me
day5_after_confront_2.text: *The footsteps grow closer. The sound of dress shoes hitting concrete. Ms. Eunsu's shoes.*

day5_after_confront_3.speaker: me
day5_after_confront_3.text: *Stopped. At the top of the stairs. Ms. Eunsu appeared. Out of breath. Hair disheveled.*

day5_after_confront_4.speaker: me
day5_after_confront_4.text: *Teacher catches her breath, forcing the corners of her mouth up. The usual gentle smile. But the facial muscles are twitching subtly.*

day5_after_confront_5.speaker: eunsu
day5_after_confront_5.text: {name}. Stop there. The emergency exit side is a restricted area.

day5_after_confront_6.speaker: me
day5_after_confront_6.text: *As I stepped back, the smile that had been clinging to Ms. Eunsu's face fell away with a snap. The mask shattered.*

day5_after_confront_7.speaker: me
day5_after_confront_7.text: *Sweat beads on her forehead. Dark circles under her eyes. I wasn't the only one who didn't sleep tonight. A cold wind from the emergency exit passed between us.*

day5_after_confront_8.speaker: eunsu
day5_after_confront_8.text: It was like this every cycle. Deviation, pursuit, recovery, reset.

day5_after_confront_9.speaker: eunsu
day5_after_confront_9.text: The 1st time, I was angry. The 2nd time, I tried to find the cause.

day5_after_confront_10.speaker: eunsu
day5_after_confront_10.text: From the 3rd time, I understood. The problem wasn't the escape. It was your eyes after the reset.

day5_after_confront_11.speaker: eunsu
day5_after_confront_11.text: So this time, I tried to stop the deviation itself.

day5_after_confront_12.speaker: eunsu
day5_after_confront_12.text: I recorded your reactions and reduced the stimuli you disliked. I thought you'd stabilize. On paper, you did.

day5_after_confront_13.speaker: eunsu
day5_after_confront_13.text: ...On Day 1, when you entered the classroom. Even though it was the 13th time, my hands shook. Even though I was opening the same report again.

day5_after_confront_14.speaker: eunsu
day5_after_confront_14.text: After 12 times, I still don't get used to it. Every time you check me with eyes seeing me for the first time, the records fall apart.

day5_after_confront_15.speaker: me
day5_after_confront_15.text: *Teacher stopped. In front of the emergency exit. Three meters from me. Teacher pulled a syringe from her pocket. Slowly. As if to show me.*

day5_after_confront_16.speaker: me
day5_after_confront_16.text: *The liquid inside the syringe glinted under the fluorescent light. — This is what erased 12 cycles of memories. One vial of clear liquid.*

day5_after_confront_17.speaker: eunsu
day5_after_confront_17.text: This is the final choice, {name}. One shot and the procedure is over. What you just saw, your fear, even your reactions to me, all of it will be cleared.

day5_after_confront_18.speaker: eunsu
day5_after_confront_18.text: Back to Day 1. To a state where you know nothing. ...Come back.

day5_after_confront_19.speaker: me
day5_after_confront_19.text: *Teacher's hand is shaking. The syringe trembles. A drop falls to the floor. Tears fell from Teacher's eyes. She didn't wipe them. An expression that knows there's no point.*

day5_after_confront_20.speaker: me
day5_after_confront_20.text: *Syringe and emergency exit. Oblivion and memory. Cage and sky. Seolhwa — is visible. Behind Teacher. At the bottom of the stairs. A blurry silhouette. Saying nothing. Just — watching me.*

day5_after_final_choice.speaker: me
day5_after_final_choice.text: *All I have to do is push past and run. This person doesn't have the strength to stop me. But my legs won't move. My body, after 12 cycles, remembers. If I follow this voice, I won't be scolded. If I return to the place her hand guides me to, I'll be safe.*

day5_after_true_1.speaker: me
day5_after_true_1.text: *Ms. Eunsu's hand trembles. The syringe fell to the floor. Glass shattered against the tile.*

day5_after_true_3.speaker: me
day5_after_true_3.text: *Teacher stepped aside. Eyes closed. As if she had no strength left to block.*

day5_after_true_4.speaker: me
day5_after_true_4.text: *I passed through the emergency exit. With Yuna. The fire escape behind the old wing.*

day5_after_true_5.speaker: me
day5_after_true_5.text: *The dawn air is cold. Beyond the school fence — the road is visible. I looked back.*

day5_after_true_6.speaker: me
day5_after_true_6.text: *Seolhwa is standing inside the emergency exit. She can't step outside the door.*

day5_after_true_10.speaker: seolhwa
day5_after_true_10.text: I waited 6 cycles. For you to get out.

day5_after_true_11.speaker: seolhwa
day5_after_true_11.text: ...I ended a year ago. ...But if you get out, that's enough.

day5_after_true_11a.speaker: me
day5_after_true_11a.text: I'll remember. Lee Seolhwa. The name you returned to me, right to the very end.

day5_after_true_12.speaker: me
day5_after_true_12.text: *Seolhwa's body turns translucent. Scattering into particles of light. That light — flows toward me. Seeps into my chest. ...It's warm. This isn't a hallucination — it's memory.*

day5_after_forget_3.speaker: me
day5_after_forget_3.text: ...If these are all my memories... then those 12 unnamed lines abandoned in that basement are all me.

day5_after_forget_4.speaker: me
day5_after_forget_4.text: I can't do it... I can't handle this. It feels like my head is going to explode...

day5_after_forget_5.speaker: me
day5_after_forget_5.text: Please erase me. Make me forget everything.

day5_after_forget_6.speaker: me
day5_after_forget_6.text: *Ms. Eunsu raised the syringe. Her hand is shaking.*

day5_after_forget_8.speaker: me
day5_after_forget_8.text: *The needle entered my arm. Cold. Consciousness fades.*

day5_after_forget_9.speaker: me
day5_after_forget_9.text: *The last thing I saw — Seolhwa. Seolhwa is crying. Her lips move. No sound.*

day5_after_forget_10.speaker: me
day5_after_forget_10.text: *...I can read it. The movement of her lips. — "Don't forget"*

day5_after_resist_2.speaker: me
day5_after_resist_2.text: You're a victim too, Teacher. You were used by the board.

day5_after_resist_4.speaker: eunsu
day5_after_resist_4.text: No. From the 3rd time on, it was my choice.

day5_after_resist_6.speaker: me
day5_after_resist_6.text: Even so. If you stay here, the 14th cycle begins. For someone else.

day5_after_resist_7.speaker: me
day5_after_resist_7.text: *Ms. Eunsu stopped. Seolhwa appeared. Behind Ms. Eunsu.*

day5_after_resist_9.speaker: seolhwa
day5_after_resist_9.text: For 6 years, I watched every day. You greeting a new me every time. Smiling every time. — Breaking a little more every time.

day5_after_resist_11.speaker: me
day5_after_resist_11.text: *Ms. Eunsu set the syringe on the floor. ...She stood there for a long time.*

day5_after_resist_12.speaker: eunsu
day5_after_resist_12.text: ...If I go outside, everything I did will come to light.

day5_after_resist_13c.speaker: eunsu_full
day5_after_resist_13c.text: The 11th Oh Taehyun... said he trusted me. That it was all right because I was his teacher.

day5_after_resist_13d.text: *The teacher stopped speaking. Their hand trembled slightly.*

day5_after_resist_13e.speaker: eunsu_full
day5_after_resist_13e.text: ...I erased the memories of that night. The next morning, he asked me, 'Who are you, miss?'

day5_after_resist_13f.speaker: eunsu_full
day5_after_resist_13f.text: That was when I knew. This wasn't a relationship. It was conditioning. And even then, I didn't stop.

day5_after_resist_13g.speaker: eunsu_full
day5_after_resist_13g.text: ...How are you going to take me away? After doing something like this to you.

day5_after_resist_14.speaker: me
day5_after_resist_14.text: *Ms. Eunsu — cried. As if the weight of 12 cycles collapsed at once. "...How can you take me with you. After what I did to you."*

day5_after_resist_15.speaker: me
day5_after_resist_15.text: ...You should face consequences. But it's better than repeating this.

day5_after_ghost_1.speaker: me
day5_after_ghost_1.text: *I can't move. My body is frozen.*

day5_after_ghost_5.speaker: seolhwa
day5_after_ghost_5.text: I watched for 6 cycles. You not being able to decide. This time too. I know. It's a habit.

day5_after_ghost_7.speaker: me
day5_after_ghost_7.text: *Seolhwa looked straight at me. A hallucination — yet never this vivid before.*

day5_after_ghost_9.speaker: me
day5_after_ghost_9.text: *My body moved. Seolhwa's voice — the memory inside me — moves my body. I grabbed Yuna's hand and ran for the emergency exit.*

day5_after_ghost_10.speaker: me
day5_after_ghost_10.text: *Ms. Eunsu shouted from behind but I didn't stop. I stepped through the emergency exit. Looked back. Seolhwa is standing inside the door. Smiling.*

day5_after_ghost_12.speaker: me
day5_after_ghost_12.text: *Seolhwa disappeared. Like light. Without a sound. At the same time — an alarm went off inside the building.*

day5_after_ghost_13.speaker: me
day5_after_ghost_13.text: *The building erupted in noise. Sirens, footsteps, shouting. ...Seolhwa is gone. Inside my head too — silence. I escaped the school.*
